content: Jesus balkajin.
Yala-yala majangka jirrayngka bama wubulku countim-bunganka. Nyulu maja Governmentanka, burri Augustus. Nyulu maja-majanda bubananda balkan, “Yurra bamanga wubulbuku burri kabanba balka.”
Yala-yalaku jana bama countim-bungan, nyulu Cyrenius maja bubuku Syriaka.
Bama wubulku janangaku townbuku dungan, janangaku burri kabanba balkanka.

Nyulu Joseph King Davidandamun. King Davidamu bubu Judea, nyungu town Bethlehem. Yinyaynka Joseph townmun Nazarethmun, bubumun Galileemun dungan, townbu Bethlehem dungan, jana nyungun countim-bunganka.
Mary dunyunji dungan, Josephanji. Jana Mary countim-bunganka Josephanji. Nyulu Mary kulngkul.

Bula Bethlehem kadan, yamba room yamba-kari hotelba. Yinyaynka bula bundan bayanba bulkindamunbu, donkeyndamunbu. Time kadanda Marymu kangkal balkajinka. Nyulu balkajinda yinyaymba bayanba bulkindamunbu. Ngawa dingkar, nyulu jakalbamun. Box yalbay yinyaymba wunan, box mayika jikanka donkeymu. Maryngka ngawa kambibu kajan, boxmunbu yijarrin.
Angel-angel nguwimal milbijin dingkar-dingkaranda.
Yala-yala kanbalda dingkar-dingkarangka sheep wubul kujil-kujin yinyaymba bubungu. Jana wujurrdurr sheep nyajil-nyajinya.
Kari. Nyulu angel kadan Godundumun, nguwimal milbijin jananda dingkar-dingkaranda. Lightmundu Godundumundu jananin balban. Jana yinyilmanda.
Kari, angelangka jananda yalaman, “Kari yinyilmaka. Ngayu kuku ngulkurr yurranda wundil. Bama wubulku wawurr-wawurrmaniji yinyaynka kukuku.
Ngawa nyiku balkajinda townbu Davidandamunbu. Nyulu balkajin yurranka. Nyulu bamanga wawu juran-bungalkuda, nyulu Maja Christ.
Yurra ngawa warrmba-bungal kambibu kajanya, wunananya boxmunbu. Yurra nyungun nyajil yinyaymba wunananya, yurra binalda, ngayu yurranda manubajabuku balkan.”
Yinyamun angel-angel wubul nguwimalmanda dingkar-dingkaranda. Jana angel-angel wulngku badin, singmanijin Godunku, nyungun buyay-maninka. Jana yalaman,
“God buyay-mana. Nyulu junkurrji bajaku. Kaki God wawurr-wawurrmaniji bamanka bubungu, yinyarrin bama wawu-ngulkurrku bundayda, milka-marrimalda.”

Yinyamun angel-angelangka jananin dingkar-dingkar bawanda, dungan baja wangkar-wangkar heavenbaku. Jana dingkar-dingkarangka jana-karrajiku yalaman, “Ngana townbu Bethlehem dungayda, yinya nyajinka Godungku ngananda balkanya.”
Jana jinbalku dungarin, bulanin Mary, Joseph warrmba-bungan, ngawa nyajin boxmunbu wunananya.
Dingkar-dingkarangka ngawa nyajin, jana bamanda balkan yinyarrinyangka angel-angelangka jananda balkan ngawanka.
Jana bamangka yinya kuku nyajin, jana kungkurr-kadan, milkabu wukurrin kuku dingkar-dingkarangka balkan.
Mary yinyayanka kari milka-wulan. Nyulu milkabu kujin, mumbarabuku milkabu wukurrin.
Dingkar-dingkar dungarin baja, God buyay-manil-manin yinyaynka jana nyajinya. Angel-angelangka jananda balkan, jana yala nyajin.
Jana Jesus burri dalkin.
Nyulu ngawa warngku 8-balaman, jana nyungun yulban yakan, burri dalkin, Jesus. Mary kulngkulmanjiku, angelangka Marynda yalaman, “Ngawa burri Jesus.”
Jana Jesus wundin Godundumunbu bayanba yalbaymba.
Jesus 40-days oldman, bula Josephangka, Maryngka ngawa Godundumunbu bayanba yalbaymba wundin townbu Jerusalem Jew-warrandamunku lawmunku.
Jew-warrandamundu lawbu yalaku balkal,

content.text: “Yurra ngawa dingkar-dingkar jakalbamun wubulku Godundumunbu bayanba wundi, Godundu dajinka.”

content: Kaki ngawa balkaji, jana minya wayjul Godunku, lawmunku. Jana yalaku. Bula minya bakamu jambul wundin, bayanga wayjunku, Godundu dajinka, Godundumunku kukuku.

Yala-yalaku nyubun wulman, burri Simeon, nyulu townbu Jerusalem bundandan. Nyulu junkayku bundan, Godunku wawu jirray. Nyulu waitmalman Godungku bama Jew-warra ngulkurr-bunganyamunku buyun-buyunmun. Godumu Wawu wulmanandamunbu dukurrbu bundan.
Godundumundu Wawubu wulmananda balkan, “Yundu kariku wulay. Ngadiku Godungku promise dajin nyulu Christ yunganka. Jakalba yundu Maja Christ nyajil, yinyamun yundu wulaykuda.
Godundumundu Wawubu wulman Simeon Godundumunbu bayanba wundin. Yala-yalaku bula Josephangka, Maryngka ngawa Jesus bayanba wundin, nyungun Godundu dajinka, lawmunku.
Simeonangka yinya ngawa barungu manin, God buyay-manin, yalaman,
“Maja, yundu nganya promiseim-ban ngayu nyungun nyajinka. Ngayu nyungun nyajinkuda, ngayu wawurr-wawurrku wulayda.
Yundu nyungun yunganda, bamanga wawu juran-bunganka. Ngayu nyungun miyilda nyajinkuda.
Yundu nyungun yungan, bamangka wubulduku nyajinka, binalmanka.
Nyulu yala light. Jana bamangka Gentile-warrangka nyungun nyajil, jana binalmalda Godunku. Jana yinya light nyajil, jana Jew-warra buyay-manil.”
Bula Josephangka Maryngka Simeonamu kuku nyajin, bula kungkurr-kadan.

Simeonangka Godundu balkan bulanka, nyungundu babajin bulanin ngulkurrduku kujinka. Nyulu Marynda yalaman, “Godungku yanyu ngawa bamban bamanga Jew-warramu wawu ngulkurr-bunganka. Yamba kanbal nyungunku wawu kari, jana wulaykuda. Kanbalda nyungun nyajil, jana kuku buyun balkal nyungunku.
Yinyamundu jana milbil wanyu jana milkabu baykal. Mary, yundu milka bujarmal yanyunku kangkalanka. Milka-bujar yala naybubu yunu wawu bakal.”

Nyubun wulbuman bunjil Godundumunbu bayanba, nyulu prophet. Nyulu Godumu kuku balkan. Burri nyungu Anna. Nganjan nyungu Phanuel. Nyulu Asherandamun. Nyulu marryman 7-yearsmunku, yinyamun nyulu bunjilmaynda, 77-yearsmunku.
Nyulu Godundumunbu bayanba bundandan, kari bawan. Nyulu yarbarrkaku God buyay-manin wungara, wujurrbu. Nyulu sometimes mayi kari nukan, God buyay-maninka, praymanijinka.

Yala-yalaku nyulu Marymu kangkal nyajin, nyulu God thankim-bungan. Kanbalda bamangka townbu Jerusalem Christ kujil-kujin, Christangka bama ngulkurr-bunganka buyun-buyunmun. Nyulu wulbumanangka Annangka jananda wubulbuku balkan ngawanka.
Jana bubunguku Nazarethku kadarin baja.
Bula Josephangka and Maryngka lawmunku work kunbay-manin, Godundumunbu bayanba. Yinyamun jana bayanbaku dungarin baja townbu Nazareth, bubungu Galilee.
Nyulu kangkal yalbayman, junkurrjiman. Nyulu binalman, dukul-ngulkurrman. God wawurr-wawurrman nyungunku.
Warru Jesus Godundumunbu bayanba yalbaymba.
Every year Jesusamu ngamu and nganjan townbu Jerusalem dungan holidaymunku Passovermunku. Bula yinyaymba Passover nukanka.
Jesus 12 years oldman, jana dungarin baja, Passover nukanka.

Passover kunbaynda, bula ngamungku, nganjanangka Jerusalem bawan, bayanbaku dunganka baja. Yamba nyulu Jesus bulanji kari dungan, nyulu townbu Jerusalem bawajin. Bula ngamu, nganjan binal kari nyulu kudamundu bawajin.
Balu nyulu jawun-karranji kankadan. Jana bama all day dungan-dungarin. Yilay-yilayman, bula jawun-karranda babajin nyungunku, nyungun nubinka.
Yamba bula nyungun kari warrmba-bungan jawun-karranji. Yinyaynka bula jurrkijin, townbuku Jerusalemku dungan baja, Jesus warrmba-bunganka.
Warngku kulurman bula nyungun warrmba-bungan Godundumunbu bayanba. Nyulu Jew-warrandamunji teacher-teacheranji bundandan, jananga kuku nyajil-nyajin, jananda baban-babajin.
Bamangka wubulduku Jesusamu kuku nyajin, jana kungkurr-kadarin. Nyulu dukul-ngulkurr, binal bajaku.

Bula ngamu-nganjanangka nyungun nyajin Godundumunbu bayanba, bula yalarrku kungkurr-kadan. Ngamungku nyungundu yalaman, “Kangkal, yundu wanyurrinku ngalinin bawan? Ngalin wawu-buyunman yununku, yunun nubil-nubin.”
Jesusangka bulanda babajin, “Yubal nganya wanyurrinku nubil-nubin? Yubal binalmanyaku ngayu ngaykuwunbu nganjanandamunbu bayanba must bunday.”
Yamba bula nyunguwunku kukuku binal kari.
Yinyamun Jesus bulanji bayanbaku dungan baja, townbuku Nazarethku. Nyulu bulanda milka-janan. Nyulu Maryngka milkabu wukurril-wukurrin Jesus, milkabu wukurrin nyulu Godundumunbu bayanba bundandanya.
Jesus yalbayman. Nyulu binalman, dukul-ngulkurrman. Nyulu God, jana bama, jana wawurr-wawurrman nyungunku.
